property_summary: For any call to transfer with non-empty arrays where the caller has sufficient allowance at the given contract_address, the reference ensures tos.length equals vs.length, causing array-mismatch calls to revert; the buggy version skips this check and proceeds with iteration over tos.length, reading out-of-bounds from vs when vs is shorter, which leads to a revert from the external call or zero-value transfer that would have been prevented, violating the invariant that such mismatched calls always fail on the length check.
change_summary: Delete the require(tos.length == vs.length) check so that the function proceeds with mismatched array lengths.
